title: Peanut Banana Ice
description: A healthy frozen dessert made from blended bananas, smooth peanut butter and salted peanuts. Creamy and satisfying.
steps: Line a 500ml freezer-safe container with cling film.
Purée the bananas in a blender until smooth. Slowly add the peanut butter, blending between each addition.
Add two-thirds of the peanuts and stir in by hand. Tip into the container and flatten the top. Scatter remaining peanuts on top.
Freeze for around 4 hours for soft-serve consistency, or 6 hours for a harder scoop.
